description: The ASDSO Dam Incident Database, produced by the Association of State Dam Safety Officials, gives basic information on dam safety incidents in the United States, both failures and non-failures. ASDSO began gathering incident information from state dam safety programs in 2010 and holds some information from federal dam owning or regulating agencies; much of the identifying information on each dam comes from the National Inventory of Dams. Coverage is the United States. The database is free to search online on ASDSO's site, with a spreadsheet to download that explains each field; the page states no licence. Caveats: ASDSO says the database does not cover all historic or current incidents, reflects only what it has been able to collect, and may contain inaccuracies. Simulation uses: incident and failure frequencies for dam risk, emergency planning and resilience studies. Related records: the worldwide historical dam failures database (data-worldwide-historical-dam-failures-database) and the National Inventory of Dams (data-usace-national-inventory-of-dams).
